name: Landing page
looksLike: one page asking me to sign up
a page selling one offer with a big action button
a focused page for an advertising campaign
definition: A focused page that explains one offer and guides visitors toward one main action, such as signing up, requesting a quote, or downloading a guide.
goal: Help visitors understand one offer and take its next step.
audience: People arriving from a campaign or referral

sections.name: Offer and action
sections.purpose: State the benefit and the single next step.

sections.name: Benefits
sections.purpose: Explain the value with a few concrete outcomes.

sections.name: Proof and questions
sections.purpose: Offer genuine evidence and address common concerns.

sections.name: Final action and details
sections.purpose: Repeat the action and provide contact and policy links.

mustHave: A labelled form with a clear success state

prompts.short: Build a landing page with one clear offer, benefits, proof, FAQs, and a primary action.
prompts.detailed: Build a landing page website for people arriving from a campaign or referral. Help visitors understand one offer and take its next step. Include offer and action, benefits, proof and questions, final action and details. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. One clear primary action.
